name: Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Ltd
about: Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Ltd is an IPR-based pharmaceutical Company engaged in producing, stocking, selling, and supplying branded and generic medicines. [1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
The company is a branded IPR-based pharmaceutical player focusing on frontier markets, with a vast and growing portfolio of prescription and OTC drugs across multiple therapeutic segments. As of 9M FY25, it has a portfolio of 897 registered products across 7 countries in Africa and Latin America serving through 38 warehouses. [1] [2] [3]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.90 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 3.82% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 93.1 to 138 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -6.87%
